end.summary:
Identified plant-eaters, meat-eaters, and animals that eat both.
Built and read food chains using arrows.
Explained that plants make their own food using sunlight and begin food chains.
Explained likely population changes when predators are removed.
end.parentNote: Manav practised grouping animals by what they eat and building food chains with arrows. They used the method of checking which organism eats the next one, and corrected the arrow-direction mix-up later in the lesson. They also explained that plants make food using sunlight and start food chains. At home, ask Manav to draw one food chain and explain what might happen if one animal is removed.
